Ivy (People Ops): quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A 2d collecting the action items on onboarding promotion promises, transfer timing, and appeals. dropping short answers and owners here so it's easy to find. :spiral_notepad:
Noah (Eng Manager): thanks. if a manager promises a promotion at 6 months during offers, is that a binding change to comp or just a promise of review?
Ivy (People Ops): it's a promise of review, not an automatic comp change. record an "Onboarding Promotion Plan" in Offer Notes and submit the promotion packet at the agreed checkpoint. final approval follows calibration + budget.
June (IC): can you paste the one-line we should include in offers so recruiters use consistent language?
Ivy (People Ops): yes 2d paste this verbatim into offer notes: "Onboarding Promotion Plan: target review at 6 months; measurable criteria attached; promotion subject to calibration and budget approval."
Omar (Recruiting): got it 2d i'll update offer playbook and use that exact line. also, should recruiters attach a copy of the goals?
Ivy (People Ops): yes please attach a short goal list (3 bullets) or link to the onboarding doc. saves confusion later.
payroll-bot: NOTE: salary changes take effect on the first payroll after HR approval. Retro-pay requires finance sign-off.
Noah (Eng Manager): transfer case: if someone moves teams mid-cycle, does their review window move?
Ivy (People Ops): default = keep original window. if role/scope materially changes, new manager can request a transfer recalibration (requires both managers + People Ops sign-off).
June (IC): appeals timeline? manager vs IC submission?
Ivy (People Ops): appeals accepted for 14 days after the calibration email. managers submit packets for direct reports; ICs should speak to their manager first. we'll add a small flowchart in the handbook update.
Ivy (People Ops): i'll publish a 1-page checklist + offer snippet by EOD tomorrow and run a 30-min manager drop-in next week. drop any other follow-ups here. :raised_hands:
